meta.note: All societies, events, people and contact details below are made up for a hackathon demo. Replace with real, approved data later.

societies.name: Night Owls Running Crew
societies.location: Meet outside the Sports Hall entrance
societies.summary: Friendly 5k evening runs at every pace. Nobody gets left behind.
societies.description: We run a relaxed 5k loop every Monday evening with pace groups from 'chatty jog' to 'tempo'. Hi-vis vests are provided, and we usually grab a hot chocolate afterwards. Brand new to running? Come along anyway, because the walk-run group is the most popular one.

societies.name: Five-a-Side Social League
societies.location: Indoor courts, City sports centre (made up)
societies.summary: Mixed-ability casual football. Turn up, get put on a team, have fun.
societies.description: There are no trials and no pressure. Each week we shuffle players into mixed teams for short five-a-side games. All genders and abilities are welcome, and we keep it friendly. Bring trainers and a water bottle.

societies.name: Boulder & Belay Collective
societies.location: Group trip from the Headingley bus stop
societies.summary: Weekend bouldering trips with kit to borrow and coaching for first-timers.
societies.description: Every Saturday we head to a local climbing wall as a group. Shoes and chalk bags are available to borrow, and experienced members run short taster sessions for anyone new. Socials follow most trips.

societies.name: Sketch & Sip
societies.summary: Laid-back drawing sessions with tea, prompts and zero judgement.
societies.description: Every week there's a different drawing prompt, from still life to character design to urban sketching. Paper and pencils are provided. You don't need any experience, and plenty of members just come for the tea and the company.

societies.name: Open Mic Collective
societies.location: Student bar stage, City campus (made up)
societies.summary: Music, poetry and comedy nights. Perform, or just come and cheer.
societies.description: We host a monthly open mic and smaller weekly jam sessions. Sign-up slots are five minutes long, and supportive audiences are guaranteed. Not ready to perform? Help with sound, lights or hosting instead.

societies.name: Lens & Light Photography
societies.location: Meet at the Headingley library steps
societies.summary: Photo walks around Leeds. Phone cameras are absolutely fine.
societies.description: Monthly photo walks explore parks, architecture and street scenes, with editing workshops in between. You can shoot on your phone or a camera. We share favourites in a friendly end-of-term exhibition.

societies.name: Code & Coffee
societies.summary: Weekly coding meet-ups, mini hackathons and peer help sessions.
societies.description: Bring a laptop and a project, or ask for one. We pair beginners with more experienced coders, run monthly mini hackathons and host talks from alumni. Any course, any level.

societies.name: Big Questions Debate Forum
societies.summary: Friendly debates on big ideas. Build confidence speaking up.
societies.description: Each week we pick a motion, from ethics to tech to pop culture, and debate it in small, friendly groups. It's great practice for presentations and interviews. Quieter members can start as timekeepers or judges.

societies.name: World Kitchen Society
societies.location: Shared kitchen space, City campus (made up)
societies.summary: Cook and share dishes from members' home countries and regions.
societies.description: Every fortnight a different member leads a cook-along of a dish from home, and then we all eat together. It's a brilliant way to meet international and home students. Ingredients are covered by a small optional contribution.

societies.name: Language Swap Café
societies.summary: Practise a new language over coffee and help others with yours.
societies.description: Tables are grouped by language, including Spanish, Mandarin, Arabic, French, Polish, English and more. Spend half the time speaking the language you're learning and half helping someone with yours. All levels are welcome.

societies.name: Green Campus Volunteers
societies.location: Meet by the Headingley main gate
societies.summary: Litter picks, tree planting and campus gardening. Gloves provided.
societies.description: Help look after green spaces on and around campus. Sessions run for about two hours and finish with snacks. It's a great way to meet people, get outdoors and add volunteering hours to your CV.

societies.name: Community Buddies
societies.summary: Volunteer with local food banks, homework clubs and charity events.
societies.description: We partner with local community groups (made-up for this demo) to run regular volunteering shifts. Training is provided, and you choose how often to get involved. Ideal if you want to give back and meet people at the same time.

societies.name: Bedroom Producers Club
societies.summary: Make beats, swap tips and finish tracks together. Laptops and headphones are all you need.
societies.description: From lo-fi to drum and bass, everyone's welcome whatever their style or skill level. Each week has a theme, such as sampling, mixing or vocals, and finishes with a 'play us your track' round. Any music software is fine, and we can show you free options.

societies.name: Sing It Out Choir
societies.summary: A no-auditions pop choir. Belt out chart hits and make friends fast.
societies.description: We sing pop, musical theatre and the odd throwback anthem, arranged in easy parts. You don't need to read music. Just show up and sing. We perform at a couple of fun gigs each term.

events.title: Glow-Stick Welcome Run
events.description: A gentle 3k loop with glow sticks and hot chocolate at the end.

events.title: Speed Portraits Night
events.description: Draw each other in two-minute rounds. A great way to meet people!

events.title: Mini Hack: Build a Bot in 2 Hours
events.description: Team up and build a simple chatbot. Starter code provided.

events.title: Dumpling Making Night
events.description: Learn to fold three styles of dumplings, then eat them all.

events.title: Winter Tree Planting
events.description: Help plant 50 saplings along the campus path. Wellies recommended.

events.title: Winter Open Mic Showcase
events.description: End-of-term showcase. Sign up on the night for a five-minute slot.

events.title: Festive Debate: Is Tinsel Overrated?
events.description: A light-hearted debate night with mince pies and silly motions.

events.title: Language Swap Board Games
events.description: Play word games in the language you're learning. All levels welcome.

events.title: Beginner Beat Battle
events.description: Make a 60-second beat from the same sample pack. Everyone gets cheered!
